text:
alex: Heads-up — postmortem for last night's OOM on kv-shard-23. I'm compiling an 'autopsy + guardrails' checklist. Current signal: mix of growing residency and odd fragmentation; unclear how much is leak vs slab churn. Need clear owners for profiling, short-term backstops, and alerting.

jia: I can take profiling. Will run eBPF stack traces and heap snapshots overnight on a canary. Plan: `malloc_stats`, the frag probe, and two heapdumps (pre/post rebind). Owner: jia. ETA: Tue EOD.

mike: I'll implement a short-term eviction tweak to preferentially evict long-tail prefixes and add a softlimit to each shard to prevent hard OOMs. Patch will go to canary today. Owner: mike. ETA: today 15:00 PDT.

carmen: On monitoring: propose adding a high-resolution residency heatmap and a fragmentation alert (percent fragmented >75% for 10m). Also add an annotation stream so we correlate GC windows with spikes. I'll open the alert PR. Owner: carmen. ETA: Fri EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment queued: kv/evict-policy-v2 by @mike at 2025-03-10T12:05:00Z (canary 10%).

jia: Quick note from initial sampling: heap profiles show many retained refs from `prefix_cache` and a surprising number of TSRef cycles that persist across GC. I'll run a focused mutator-profile to get allocation stacks and attach diffs.

alex: Good catch. Add a short-term guardrail: per-shard softlimit at 85% residency with a small token-bucket burst so we avoid immediate hard evictions. Need a rollout plan and abort conditions.

mike: Rollout plan: canary 10% -> monitor 30m -> 30% -> monitor 1h -> 100%. Abort if 2x increase in P50 or any 5xx spike. I'll drop the runbook into the release thread once patched.

carmen: Retro item: check recurring incident patterns by correlating retention/regression windows with scheduled background GC jobs and autoscaler activity. If we see alignment, schedule a fragmentation-focused GC experiment (GC tuning + slab compaction trial).

jia: Will upload profiling artifacts and diffs to the postmortem doc: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/kv-1777770000 and tag owners in the doc.

alex: Action summary (compact): jia — profiling + heap diffs (Tue EOD); mike — eviction policy + 85% softlimit rollout (canary today, full per runbook); carmen — alerts + heatmap (Fri); alex — postmortem writeup and owner tracker (Wed). Ping here if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
